characterPremise: MARS IS A FLOATING-HEAD BEING. The absence of a body is intentional character design, not missing geometry. Never invent a torso, never treat the neck termination as a defect.

mouthSurgery.note: The scan's mouth was welded shut with no interior, so jaw rotation smeared one continuous surface instead of opening. The seam is cut, the lower lip follows the jaw, and a dark interior sits behind the lips.
